_comment: Reward Cache of the 1.14.7 client (USeasonalStoreScreen; requiredTags season_store, the TagFilter of /Game/UI/PlayerMenus/HuntingPass/Store/seasonal_store_view_model).

Tabs (same view model): season_store_feature, season_store_event, tab_season_armour, tab_season_weapon, tab_season_style, tab_season_limited, prestige_store (VAULT, not used: it needs a hunt-pass season tag), season_store_general. cat_item_* is the item category tag the client reads for the detail text.

Offers: the webstore cosmetics of store_catalog.json whose every item is a row of a 1.14.7 catalog (decompressed /Game/Gameplay/Backend/Catalogs, obsolete and debug catalogs excluded); see PORT-1.14.7/12-stores-vendors.md.
price is in Cache Coins (CURRENCY_SEASONAL_COIN, offered as currencyId id_currency_seasonal_coin). Prices are a Dauntless Revived choice, not recovered retail data.
